neighbours.label: digits of a number that pairs with an earlier number (slash splits, unit conversions, lists), against a number standing alone in prose
fire: The vote split was 52/37/11 across the county.
The front tires are 245/40 and the rear ones wider.
The loop trail runs 2.6 miles / 4.2 km through pines.
Each bag covers 500 sq. ft. (46 sq. meters) of lawn.
The box weighs 88 lb (39.9 kg) when full.
Reported ranges were 1,240-2,380 acres (502-963 hectares) per herd.
The table lists widths of 120/70/55 for the three models.
quiet: The vote was held in 37 towns across the county.
The front tires lasted 40 days and the rear ones longer.
The loop trail runs through 42 acres of tall pines.
Each bag feeds the whole lawn for about 46 days.
The sequence starts at noon and ends with 54 guests.
The box gets heavy when full of 39 books.
Reported herds had about 380 animals in the valley.
The table lists 70 models from the last few years.

notes: Top examples peak mostly on '3', but probes fired on other digits in the same setting, so the context is the claim. Bare '3 dogs' stayed quiet.
